cases.topic: Whether Second Amendment effects survive into Eighth A&R
cases.detail: Eighth A&R is a restatement of a later vintage. Applying Seventh-era Second Amendment effects onto Eighth A&R without restatement analysis would be an authority error. No conclusion asserted here without comparing Eighth A&R definition text.
